name: A slow Saturday in the neighborhood

scenes.title: A free morning
scenes.body: The market is opening, the river path is quiet, and there is a little time before lunch. Where would you like to begin?

scenes.title: Beside the water
scenes.body: A bench catches the morning sun. Farther along, a footbridge leads toward a community garden.

scenes.title: A few useful things
scenes.body: Someone is selling fresh bread. A handwritten sign invites visitors to a shared garden after the market.

scenes.title: A place to grow
scenes.body: You help water a row of seedlings and meet someone new. A small morning becomes a good story to take home.

scenes.title: One quiet chapter
scenes.body: You settle beside the river, read a chapter, and let the rest of the morning arrive slowly.

scenes.title: Breakfast at the table
scenes.body: The bread is still warm. You open a window and make a little space for the day.
